rows.quote: Plasma-protein instruments were derived from UKB-PPP cis-pQTL summary statistics, infection outcomes from FinnGen R13, and follow-up pQTL regions from ProteoNexus [5,12,13].
rows.coder_note: The sentence names release R13 of FinnGen; the dictionary's FinnGen rows stop at R12, so the named release has no row.

UKB-PPP is attributed to Sun 2023 (ref 5, several dictionary rows); no sentence that attributes the dataset gives a subcohort, ancestry or sample size separating the rows. 'Predominantly European ancestry' in the Discussion is a general remark outside the attribution sentence (rule E not met).
